transkript.t: Every billionaire on earth is panicking right now,
because someone just builds a free GitHub repo
that lets you run a whole company of AI employees
and it already has over 110,000 stars.
This is AI Agent Gems, part one.
It's called Paperclip.
Say you want to launch a software business.
Normally, you'd hire developers, designers,
a marketer, and someone to manage them all.
With Paperclip, you build an org chart
of AI agents instead.
One is your CEO, one is your CTO,
a few are developers, and one runs marketing.
Then you give them one goal,
build and launch an AI note taking app.
You don't brief every agent yourself.
Your AI CEO breaks the goal into tasks,
hands them out, and keeps everyone working together.
But here's where it gets crazy.
They keep working on schedules
even when you're not chatting with them.
And you watch it all from one dashboard.
Every task, every update,
and exactly what each agent spends on tokens.
Set budgets, approve the big decisions,
and pause any agent when you need to.
It works with cloud code, codecs, open claw, and more.
And the whole thing is free and open source.
I teach everyday people and business owners
how to save time and grow revenue with AI agents.
The full setup is in my AI community.
Comment agents and I'll send you the link.
